summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The CastleArk Large Growth ETF (CARK) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is an actively managed fund of large-cap growth companies. Securities are selected using a mix of quantitative metrics and a bottom-up fundamental approach. CARK was launched on Dec 6, 2023 and is issued by CastleArk.

holdings.infoBox: CARK is an equity ETF with a total of 30 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 13.88%, Alphabet at 9.59%, Apple at 6.41%, Arista Networks at 5.34%, and Eli Lilly and Company at 5.29%.
